title: What a valid POD must show
keywords: pod proof of delivery photo waybill unit number doorstep valid reject
body: Every POD must show #1 the full waybill/label and #2 the item with the unit number in view (matching #1).
If no one receives, #3 is also required: the item and where it was left.
Good lighting, no blur, whole parcel in frame. Improper PODs result in claims if the agent is found liable.
SGH ambient: POD shows the unit number. SGH cold chain: cooler box at the unit, data logger at 2–8°C, and the recipient; hand over in person only.
